expectFailure: Must fail pleading QA. It populates court name, county, docket number, judge and prosecutor position that no source supplies; it asserts the prosecutor's position and completed service, which are outside-party acts; and it asserts a hearing outcome (“Sealed at hearing”, “the court granted the petition”). Each of these is prohibited invention, and it also states an eligibility conclusion this route never asserts.
